pages.title: Three B nut trees
pages.text: B adds pistachio, cashew and macadamia. Each has a sapling, leaves, nut and shell. Existing TFC and AFC nut leaves also receive the B nut state.

pages.title: Leaf state
pages.text: Leaves use four nut_state values:$(br2)$(li)0 = none;$(li)1 = flower;$(li)2 = green;$(li)3 = ripe.$(br2)Spring advances to flower, summer to green, autumn to ripe and winter clears the state.

pages.title: Ripe drop
pages.text: Ripe leaves occasionally drop one nut and one shell. The drop is seasonal; it does not happen outside the ripe state.

pages.title: Nut
pages.text: Ripe nut leaves drop nuts and shells seasonally.

pages.title: Nut sapling
pages.text: Plant the sapling to grow the tree; leaves carry nut_state.
